name: Atlas of Economic Complexity GraphQL API
summary: Keyless GraphQL API for Harvard Growth Lab trade data and economic complexity metrics (ECI, product complexity, RCA) for countries and products.
description: The API behind the Atlas of Economic Complexity serves country-year indicators (GDP, GDP per capita, population, export and import values, ECI, COI), country-product-year trade flows with revealed comparative advantage and market share, product classifications (HS92, HS12, SITC), location groups, product space and growth-projection lookbacks. Queries are GraphQL POSTs; the endpoint also serves a GraphiQL explorer with the full schema.

required_headers.name: User-Agent
required_headers.notes: A request with an empty User-Agent returned 403.

rate_limit.summary: 120 requests per minute (documented on the API docs page).

endpoints.summary: Single GraphQL endpoint; JSON body {"query": "..."}. Queries include countryYear, countryProductYear, locationCountry, productHs92, countryProfile and productSpace

example.body: {"query": "{ countryYear(countryId: 156, yearMin: 2021, yearMax: 2022) { year gdp gdppc population exportValue importValue eci } }"}

license.name: Growth Lab Atlas data terms (see the Atlas site); license not re-confirmed

coverage.temporal: Annual trade data from the 1960s-1990s to recent years depending on classification

agent_notes: Open the endpoint in a browser for GraphiQL and the schema. countryId takes the numeric M49-style code (156 = China, 840 = USA); locationCountry lists countries with their string ids and ISO3 codes. Product ids are internal numbers, not HS codes; use the product queries to map them. Filter in the query (yearMin, yearMax, productLevel, productClass) and request only the fields you need.
caveats: The provider states public access is a courtesy; endpoints and values may change suddenly, and it is meant for stand-alone analysis rather than as a backend for other software.
An older path atlas.hks.harvard.edu/api/countries/graphql also answered with a different schema; use the documented /api/graphql.
Requests with an empty User-Agent returned 403.

verification.notes: Exact example POST executed without a key; 200 with application/json and CORS *.
